trackDescription: Focuses on Slalom’s business by delivering capabilities and offerings to customers, and supports business growth through excellent delivery. Leaders in this track are accountable for ensuring the successful delivery of team projects and cultivating talent within their teams.
jobTitleSummary: Accountable for organizational culture and operational health. Positions Slalom for long-term market leadership by driving transformational changes at an organizational level, and building strategic relationships that drive client value, innovation, and enhance Slalom's competitive advantage.

Deliver Exceptionally.expectation: Oversees and integrates project / program governance, driving Delivery Excellence.
Owns prioritization and deliberate tradeoffs at scale for growth outcomes for clients, Slalom, and team members.
Accountable for risk management, mitigating patterns of business, client, and operational risks.

Guides teams in developing transformational solutions that drive measurable impact to client organization and leadership structures; plays an active role in the Delivery Quality Review process (e.g., Continuous Quality Advisor).
Informs innovation strategies and investments, helping customers stay ahead of industry trends and market disruptions.
Convincingly articulates short- and long-term impacts and outcomes on client businesses to executive stakeholders. Institutionalizes measurement frameworks that prioritize client value realization.
Masters the ability to craft high-impact, audience-specific written communications, ensuring clarity, precision, and strategic alignment in executive briefings and organizational communications.
Masters the ability to read an audience and influence executive stakeholders to build trust, create accountability, and drive clear decisions in the most critical and strategic discussions.
Nurtures key strategic relationships with across client leadership structures to serve delivery needs.
Influences client strategy and guides decision-making to drive innovation, growth, and competitive advantage.
Drives a culture of customer-centricity, as evidenced through Customer Love strategies and scores.
Champions the effective and ethical use of emerging technologies (e.g., AI, AI agents) to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes.
Accountable for delivery and management of complex projects across capabilities, geographies, outcomes and/or industries.
Sets up value-based deals that drive sustained and ongoing revenue.
Drives Slalom’s narrative, leveraging client successes and industry insights to position the firm as a global leader.
Sets a future-focused agenda for delivering value to clients—anticipates disruptions, identifies new ways to measure and articulate success.
Cultivates a culture of value-driven client service across all Slalom levels, embedding best practices into training and mentorship.

Grow Expertise.expectation: Deepens and/or broadens mastery in Functional / Technical roles (e.g., Advanced+ 2+; Expert in 1+).
Develops in Engagement roles (e.g., Accountable Executive, SME).
Develops in Pursuit Roles (e.g., Sales Solution Lead, Accountable Executive).
Develops and upskills as a People Leader.
Drives talent development strategy in line with the all-Slalom strategy for the capability area.
Promotes culture of continuous learning by championing Learning and Development, providing guidance and resources, and positioning Slalom as an industry leader in talent growth.
Drives knowledge management strategy, in line with Slalom strategy.
Advocates for continuous improvement of solutions, leveraging firm-wide delivery expertise to drive innovation, differentiation, and sustained client success.
Defines and promotes learning priorities around  capability, solution, and/or industry trends in alignment with Slalom's strategy and ways of working.
Leads communities focused on capability and delivery best practices (e.g., capability-specific, Delivery Excellence, etc.).
Sought out for and actively shares expertise internally and externally, mentoring colleagues by sharing insights and providing opportunities for shadowing across the organization.

Acts as a catalyst for organizational curiosity, empowering teams to question the status quo and investigate and pursue bold innovations. Demonstrates expert knowledge of capability, industry, and/or solutions.

Grow Slalom.expectation: Cultivates a strategic professional network of senior-level leaders to enhance collaboration and expand client base, strengthening Slalom's market position and long-term success.
Sets the standard for Slalom brand stewardship within the organization, ensuring that teams prioritize brand integrity and excellence in their work.
Nurtures key strategic relationships with across Slalom leadership structures to optimize delivery / capability work.
Sponsors Slalom initiatives internally and/or in the community (e.g., employee resource groups, learning events, etc.); inspires participation, ownership, and innovation at all levels.
Upholds Slalom culture across capability by integrating Slalom values into business operations, leadership practices, and employee experiences.

Accountable for business strategy and planning for discipline, sub-capability, and capability, and applying it in context of office or geography, looking ahead, prioritizing effectively, and aligning to Slalom strategy.

Accountable for operational and financial health of capability, sub-capability, or discipline (e.g., staffing, utilization, billable hours, team size, bill rates). Conducts semi-annual strategic review of margin by business and by level.
Educates other leaders on Slalom financial and performance KPI measurement.
Optimizes capability talent landscape at the region or country level(s).
Accountable for capability talent strategy, processes, and decisions (e.g., talent acquisition, staffing, bench management, performance management, engagement, retention, compensation, firing).
Proactively identifies and relays opportunities for Slalom in a variety of delivery environments and/or areas of expertise.
Contributes to sales solutioning and/or oversees pursuits, especially in the context of delivery environments, to help proactively shape deals and ensure a smooth transition from sales to delivery.

Shapes and evolves the long-term strategy for Slalom and capability by integrating market trends, business performance, and future client needs. Anticipates shifts in market demand, proactively steering capability strategy and investments to position Slalom for sustained growth and relevance.
Holds leaders accountable for engagement financial health and champions the use of financial management best practices.
Team member facilitates leader succession and strategic development decisions in alignment with future leader needs and company strategy.

Lead.expectation: Creates systems and processes that help others effectively manage their energy and attention.
Drives a leadership culture that balances performance with sustainability.
Reflection integrates cultural nuances and embraces complexity/paradox; models reflection for others.
Proactively engages in career development planning, in the context of current and future business leadership needs.
Models high self-awareness and emotional intelligence.
Fosters a culture of shared accountability for psychological safety and a sense of inclusion and belonging.
Promotes a leadership culture that values transparency and conflict resolution agility.
Creates a culture where giving and requesting clear and constructive feedback (e.g., on-demand, performance reviews, end-of-engagement) is the norm.
Models behaviors expected of leaders and seeks feedback as a co-creative learning process that deepens mutual growth.
Co-creates and drives change with compassion, understanding impacts on individuals and teams.
Champions adaptive leadership at all levels, enabling the organization to evolve with business and market shifts.
Deeply understands Slalom's strategic priorities and builds / enables team strategy to support it.
Leads the alignment and sharing of organizational and strategic updates in a timely fashion to provide direction and support connection to Slalom priorities.
Understands team member career aspirations and interests, growth trajectory, engagement, and organizational impact.
Actively supports team member career development planning, with a focus on high-impact experiences and intentional mobility.
Anticipates future needs at Slalom and builds a strong pipeline of leaders.
Establishes and communicates performance expectations across the business unit, ensuring consistency across teams.
Holds leaders accountable for addressing individual and team performance gaps.
Oversees calibration discussions, ensuring rigor, fairness, and strategic alignment. Ensures team performance ratings reflect business impact.

quantitativeExpectations: Personal Contribution Credit (PCC): • Low: $2M • Target: $3.5M • High: $5M+
Business Outcome Targets: Individuals will work with their leaders to determine the business outcome that makes sense for their individual situation based on market maturity & complexity.
